title: vacant possession clause
content: To put the purchaser into immediate possession of the property and remove all the impediments in the way of such possession.

title: quiet enjoyment clause
content: The PURCHASER shall at all times have quiet and peaceful possession of the property without any interruption and or interference whatsoever by or from the VENDOR or any other person claiming by title paramount or in trust.

title: covenant to pay outgoings
content: The Donee hereby covenants with the Donor to pay all lawful rates and levies in respect of the said property as may be prescribed by the Government from time to time.

title: release of interest clause
content: To completely divest himself of all rights, estates, interests and or claims on the property.

title: further assurance clause
content: To assist the purchaser to obtain any consent, instrument or authority that may be required or necessary for the purpose of effectual transfer of the piece or parcel of land herein conveyed.

title: indemnity clause
content: To indemnify the purchaser, his executors, assigns and successors-in-title with the entire purchase price, expenses, costs and all other demand incidental to the purchase price and development of the piece or parcel of land conveyed, in the event of any defects in the Vendors' title to the property or right to convey the same, or the vendor unsuccessfully defending his rights against any claimants or claimants.
